caption: The drawing consists of three main black line illustrations on a plain, off-white background. The upper left section shows a circular object with a scalloped edge, bordered by two concentric circles, attached at the bottom to a rectangular segment with ridged detailing. To the right of this, there is a side view of a similarly detailed object resembling a hooked or curved bracket with ornamental elements, including horizontal lines near the top and bottom, a bulbous end, and a stylized support arm. In the lower left section of the page, there is a decorative crest composed of a central shield featuring three bell-like shapes and a horizontal bar, surrounded by elaborate scrollwork, with a bird perched atop the shield. The bottom right corner contains a signature that reads "Lawrence Flynn" in cursive handwriting. The overall composition places the technical and decorative illustrations on a lightly stained or aged background.
title: Silver Tankard: Details
